<title level="1" right="Class Feature 5">[Trackless Journey](/Classes.aspx?ID=36)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 152

**Class** Ranger
</column>

---

When you move through natural terrains, you are hard to track. You always gain the benefits of the [Cover Tracks](/Actions.aspx?ID=65) action in such terrains, without moving at half your Speed.
name: Trackless Journey
